The main takeaway from our work is that

the gap survival factor is significantly enhanced for events with a large rapidity gap, which makes the signal-to-background ratio for the $b \bar{b}$ decay mode of the Higgs boson in the central region much more promising than previously thought.
the gap survival factor is not a free parameter, but can be determined from a fit to data on Z production with gaps.
